items.name: The first stamping of a slice hands out its identities in file order
items.rule: A slice's first stamping hands out its item identities from 1, in file order

items.name: The slice is the directory name up to its first dash, verbatim
items.rule: A slice's first stamping hands out its item identities from 1, in file order

items.name: A deleted scenario's number is never handed out again
items.rule: Stamping again continues the slice's numbering and never reuses a number

items.name: Stamping twice changes nothing
items.rule: Stamping again continues the slice's numbering and never reuses a number

items.name: Rewording a scenario keeps its item identity
items.rule: Stamping again continues the slice's numbering and never reuses a number

items.name: No spec found for a slice never stamped
items.rule: Stamping refuses a spec it cannot read as the slice's own

items.name: A spec that went missing is "no spec found", never "fully stamped"
items.rule: Stamping refuses a spec it cannot read as the slice's own

items.name: Only the file's unstamped scenarios, in file order, are stamped
items.rule: Stamping refuses a spec it cannot read as the slice's own

items.name: A Scenario heading with nothing after the colon is reported, not stamped
items.rule: An empty-title heading is not an item, and the stamper says so out loud

items.name: A stamping that hides an empty-title heading is refused
items.rule: An empty-title heading is not an item, and the stamper says so out loud

items.name: A Scenario Outline is stamped and a Scenario Template is not
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: A heading whose title is only whitespace is a scenario
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: A stamped item's title is the heading's title with surrounding whitespace stripped
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: An item tag separated from its heading by a blank line does not stamp it
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: Tags that are not item tags do not make a scenario stamped
items.rule: One reading of Gherkin decides what is a scenario and what stamps it

items.name: The checklist holds one stamped item per stamped scenario of the source cut
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: The checklist reads the spec as the stamper does: file order, Rule, source line and trimmed title
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: A planned or backlog slice left out of the checklist is on record
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: Every unstamped scenario of every file refuses the checklist and is listed
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: A checklist that would hold no stamped item is refused
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: A stamped item whose item identity the stamper never handed out is refused
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: A stamped item with an empty title is refused
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written

items.name: Item verdicts for a cycle whose source cut has no checklist are refused
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only

items.name: Zero item verdicts file nothing, never every item failed
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only

items.name: A verdict that is neither pass nor fail is refused before an unknown item
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only

items.name: A verdict for an item not on the checklist is refused
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only

items.name: The measurement holds every checklist item once, in checklist order
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

items.name: An item with no verdict is filed as fail with the reason unreached and counted
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

items.name: An outage reads differently from a regression, and the verdict stays pass or fail
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

items.name: Duplicate verdicts: the last filed stands and the earlier ones are listed as superseded
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

items.name: A verdict filed without evidence carries empty evidence
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

items.name: A score with zero item verdicts filed is refused
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted

items.name: A baseline cycle's scoreboard rates every item and has no previous cycle
items.rule: The scoreboard is reported once a cycle, to a person, never into the loop

items.name: A scoreboard for a cycle with no measurement filed is refused
items.rule: The scoreboard is reported once a cycle, to a person, never into the loop

items.name: A cycle after an unscored one is compared with the last measured cycle, not the one before it
items.rule: A cycle is compared with the last measured cycle of the same selection, both directions apart, never a net

items.name: Newly passing and newly failing shared items are counted apart, with no net
items.rule: A cycle is compared with the last measured cycle of the same selection, both directions apart, never a net

items.name: The comparison is restated on the shared items only when the item set moved
items.rule: A cycle is compared with the last measured cycle of the same selection, both directions apart, never a net

items.name: A rate exactly on a half rounds to the even digit
items.rule: A rate has one decimal, rounded half to even, and "n/a" over zero

items.name: A previous cycle with no shared item rates the shared items "n/a"
items.rule: A rate has one decimal, rounded half to even, and "n/a" over zero

items.name: The instrument maintainer moves a golden for a recorded reason
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from

items.name: "Spec grew" over a diff that is not additions only is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from

items.name: A move without a note is refused
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from

items.name: A golden is never moved for a reason outside the three
items.rule: A golden moves only with one recorded reason, and the scenario it was written from
